sources.summary: webAI has released TwIL-LM, a family of formal-logic models at 1.7B and 3B parameters that translate English into first-order logic and check whether conclusions follow from premises. The 3B runs on CPU or 4GB of VRAM; the 1.7B downloads at 1.06GB. Both ship under a non-commercial license. The model card also shows that the headline benchmark scores belong to an unreleased checkpoint, not the weights on the Hub. The post webAI Releases TwIL-LM: A 1.7B and 3B Formal-Logic Model Family for Autoformalization on Local Hardware appeared first on MarkTechPost .
